title: Heinrich Weber, Lehrbuch der Algebra: German LaTeX and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Heinrich Weber Lehrbuch der Algebra record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record contains German source transcription, English translation working drafts, source scans, repair ledgers, and cumulative readers.

Pending local update. The next Weber upload should add Weber_Cumulative_ThreeVolumes_Batch137_FinalActiveGapClosure_Vol1_BulkAudit_20260613.zip, Weber_Cumulative_ThreeVolumes_Batch138_RecursiveHeuristicAudit_ControlFootnoteFix_20260613.zip, and Weber_B139_heuristic_fix.zip. Batch137 is a recursive active-ledger closure and Volume I bulk scan-review package, not a new linear continuation endpoint and not a critical edition. Batch138 is a focused Volume II section 6 control-character footnote fix. B139 is a focused off-ledger Volume II English section 49 repair splitting merged display tag 5--6 into source-aligned equations (5) and (6) and adding a recursive range-tag scan rule.

Status at a glance. Volume I is represented as a repaired/source-scan-audited working edition; Volume II has cumulative German/English reader material through section 176 plus localized recursive repairs; Volume III remains the current repaired cumulative from the earlier baseline. Batch137 supersedes the local Batch136 ledger status and reports the active 112-row ledger at 112/112 closed, but includes off-ledger next-work caveats. Batch138 and B139 are narrow post-closure/off-ledger repairs. OCR, display ledgers, and core-intake patch CSVs are omission guards and locator layers, not independent authority.

Quality note. These are working/source-witnessed drafts and repair packets, not certified critical editions. Some Weber continuation and audit ranges have known compression/omission risk, and Batch137's included Volume II patch candidates should not be treated as applied fixes unless later integrated. Readers should verify important formulas, theorem statements, tables, and notation against the included source witnesses and ledgers.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
